headline: Academic Mastery, Scholarships & Campus Budget Control
summary: Curated academic study systems, open-access textbooks, aid programs, and early-career launchpads for students.

advice.title: Active Recall Over Passive Rereading
advice.guidance: Replace long highlighting sessions with 25-minute spaced-repetition quizzes and teach-back summaries.
advice.actionStep: Outline three practice questions after your next lecture or study block.

advice.title: Map Aid & Semester Cash Flow Early
advice.guidance: Track scholarships, grants, and textbook expenses per semester rather than waiting until finals week.
advice.actionStep: Add a dedicated semester textbook or tuition buffer to your Finance Goals.

advice.title: Turn Class Projects Into Career Proof
advice.guidance: Document outcomes, code repositories, or research abstracts while coursework is fresh so internships become easier to win.
advice.actionStep: Update your profile bio with one measurable project milestone.
